verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a code-first Python framework, and Pipecat Cloud publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 REST API. Its private API manages agents, secrets, builds, regions and organization settings, its public API starts sessions, and an official CLI covers deploy, init and eval. That is broad programmatic coverage, but no evidence explicitly claims or verifies parity with the Cloud dashboard UI. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or a mapping of dashboard features to endpoints, and independent hands-on corroboration that every UI action is API-accessible.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The private API (/v1...) manages agents, secrets, builds, regions, and organization settings.
